Extract command processing from main
commitResults.messageBody:
The main method currently handles application startup, input reading, command dispatch, task mutation, parsing, and output in one long method. This makes the control flow difficult to read and increases the cost of future command changes.

Extract command-specific processing into focused private methods while keeping the existing task storage, parsing behavior, and user-visible output unchanged. This reduces the size and responsibility of main and makes each command path easier to understand and maintain.

Load saved Todo, Deadline, and Event tasks when Yanny starts and preserve completion status across sessions.

Add isolated UI fixtures and a two-process smoke test for startup loading.

commitResults.messageTitle: Harden task persistence error handling
commitResults.messageBody: Validate task data and configured paths before reading or writing. Use atomic file replacement and preserve in-memory state when a save fails, while reporting malformed storage files with a user-facing startup error.

Extract session UI from Yanny
commitResults.messageBody:
Yanny currently owns terminal input and session messages alongside its
command loop. Move those interactions into Ui so the entry point focuses
on coordinating commands. Preserve the existing transcript and error
handling while making later UI extraction smaller.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move command result display into Ui
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandProcessor still formats task lists and mutation responses,
splitting terminal output across classes. Route those messages
through Ui while preserving the existing transcript and the order
of save operations and success messages.

This keeps command handling focused on task behavior and prepares for
extracting Parser and TaskList in later increments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandProcessor previously mixed command execution with parsing task
values and task numbers. Move those validation and construction rules
into Parser so command handling can focus on applying task changes.

Keep existing command routing and error messages unchanged to make
this extraction easy to verify against the CLI transcripts.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move command classification into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandProcessor still inspected raw input to choose a handler, so
command interpretation was split between it and Parser. Move handler
selection into Parser and dispatch using a command type.

Preserve the existing whitespace and case rules, error messages, and
task execution behavior while preparing for TaskList extraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract TaskList from CommandProcessor
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandProcessor previously owned the raw task collection and checked
indexes itself. Move ordered task storage, list operations, and range
validation into TaskList so command handling uses a domain object.

Keep save and rollback coordination in CommandProcessor to preserve
existing output and in-memory state when persistence fails.

commitResults.messageTitle: Rename task file helper to Storage
commitResults.messageBody:
The file helper already loads and saves tasks, but its writer-only
name obscures that responsibility. Rename it to Storage and update
CommandProcessor to use the clearer dependency.

Keep the file format, path selection, and existing error handling
unchanged so stored tasks remain compatible.

commitResults.messageTitle: Wire Yanny components at startup
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandProcessor previously created Storage and loaded tasks while
also executing commands. Let Yanny assemble Storage, TaskList, Ui,
and CommandProcessor at startup so each component has a clear role.

Preserve the existing loading error message and command-loop behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge A-MoreOOP refactor into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Integrate the incremental Ui, Parser, TaskList, and Storage
extractions after CLI and persistence verification. Keep each
iteration as a separate commit for review, including the startup
wiring cleanup that makes component ownership explicit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse deadline dates and times
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline values were stored as raw text, so Yanny could not
validate calendar dates or display them consistently. Parse ISO dates
and day/month/year times into Java date values, then show them in a
readable format.

Save typed values in canonical ISO form while keeping older free-text
deadlines loadable. Extend UI and persistence coverage and document
the accepted formats.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task search by description
commitResults.messageBody:
Yanny could list every task but could not narrow the list when a user
remembered only part of a description. Add a case-insensitive find
command that searches descriptions and reports matches with their
original task numbers.

Keep search read-only, reject missing keywords, and document the new
command with UI coverage for matches and no matches.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refine Yanny user guide for release
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide was longer than users need and left startup steps indirect.
Make the Java requirement and launch command explicit, group related
commands, and clarify date formats, task numbers, and saved task data.
This gives new users a shorter path from setup to everyday use.
